title: erddap-grid: a STAC Collection for an ERDDAP dataset
description: A STAC Collection describing one ERDDAP dataset (griddap or tabledap) referenced in place: where the server is, what it serves, its datacube axes and variables, and a Parquet query template. Written by erddap-places catalog/build_erddap_collections.ts; read by erddap-places app/src/lib/catalog.ts and the extract engine. STAC core is out of scope (checked elsewhere): only type, stac_version, id and the profile's own fields are constrained, and other keys pass through. The erddap-places: keys keep their published prefix; their rename to erddap: is a build week 1 migration.

stac_extensions.description: the extension schema URLs; must declare the datacube extension 2.2.0

erddap:base_url.description: the ERDDAP server the app and the engine query, ending in /erddap (no trailing slash)

erddap:upstream_url.description: the ERDDAP server the dataset is re-served from, when base_url is a mirror

erddap:dataset_id.description: the ERDDAP datasetID, in the server's case

erddap:protocol.description: the ERDDAP service the dataset is read through

erddap:version.description: the ERDDAP version of base_url, e.g. 2.29

erddap:cors.description: true when base_url sends CORS headers, so a browser can query it directly

erddap:formats.description: the file types the server answers for this dataset (parquet, parquetWMeta, csvp, json ...)

erddap:lon_range.description: [min, max] longitude convention of the dataset's axis: [-180, 180] or [0, 360]

erddap:lat_descending.description: true when the latitude axis runs north to south, so a griddap constraint is written [(lat_max):1:(lat_min)]

erddap-places:depth.description: the depth level (m) a griddap dataset with a depth axis is sliced at; the asset template already holds it

erddap-places:status.description: pending: described but not served by base_url yet; the app lists it greyed out and nothing is precomputed

erddap-places:long_format.description: a long-format tabledap table: one row per (sample, quantity), so a cube:variables key is a value of type_column, not a column

type_column.description: the column naming the quantity of a row (e.g. measurement_type)

value_column.description: the column holding the value of the row (e.g. measurement_value)

cube:dimensions.description: the datacube dimensions: time always, latitude and longitude for griddap, depth when the dataset has one. Other datacube keys of a dimension pass through.

extent.description: [first, last] as ISO 8601 strings; last is null for an open-ended (live) dataset

step.description: an ISO 8601 duration (P1D, P1M); null or absent for irregular steps
the grid spacing in degrees; null or absent for an irregular axis

reference_system.description: an EPSG code, WKT2 string or PROJJSON object (datacube)

step.description: the grid spacing in degrees; null or absent for an irregular axis

reference_system.description: an EPSG code, WKT2 string or PROJJSON object (datacube)

depth.description: the depth axis (z), when the dataset has one

step.description: the level spacing; null or absent for irregular levels

values.description: the depth levels, for an irregular axis

cube:variables.description: the variables of the dataset, by name (for a long-format table, by value of long_format.type_column). Other datacube keys of a variable pass through.

dimensions.description: the cube:dimensions keys the variable spans, in order

type.description: data for a measured quantity, auxiliary for a coordinate or flag

unit.description: the unit as the server reports it; null when it has none

description.description: what the variable is, in a few words

erddap-places:categorical.description: true for a class-valued variable (e.g. bleaching alert area): summarised as class shares, never as a mean

erddap-places:classes.description: the label of each class value of a categorical variable, keyed by the value as a string

assets.description: the assets; at least one has roles including data and type application/vnd.apache.parquet, whose href is the query template ({variable}, {t0}, {t1}, {lat_min} ... placeholders)

href.description: the query template (a string; its placeholders are not parsed here)

cube:dimensions.description: a griddap dataset has latitude and longitude axes
